4 And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. 5 For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. 6 And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. - Matt 24:4-6 (KJV)

Satan, working through people, is the great deceiver, and it is one of his greatest tools, as he seeks to steal, kill and destroy us (John 10:10). To protect yourself against the deception of the devil, you must put on the whole amour of God (Ephesians 6:11). The devil has no real power, but has to use the power that man has, by working through a person.
